memories.text: User is a budget-constrained renter with a fixed £2,400/month whole-flat cap who treats value, safety, and commute as the core decision criteria, using commute to UCL Bloomsbury as the primary anchor and tiebreaker for location choice.

User prefers structured, evidence-based comparisons and ranking rationale over open-ended property browsing, wanting transparent, well-labeled evidence and practical context (viewing guidance, weather, transport) before committing to listings.

User is a budget-constrained renter with a fixed £2,400/month whole-flat cap who anchors location decisions on commute to UCL Bloomsbury, using value and safety to differentiate otherwise comparable central/north London areas.
User is a budget-conscious renter prioritizing value, safety, and commute efficiency, with a fixed £2,400/month whole-flat budget and a UCL Bloomsbury commute anchoring location decisions.

User strongly prefers structured, evidence-based comparisons and ranking rationale over open-ended property browsing, wanting transparent, well-labeled evidence (including cached/fixture data and explicit gaps) before committing to listings.
Commute proximity to Bloomsbury is the likely primary tiebreaker, with practical context (viewing guidance, weather, transport) valued alongside ranking evidence to support an informed decision.
